Source: BuyFromAuction’s full in-stock export from 23 October 2026, covering items priced ₹100 to ₹45,500. Identical listings at the same price are grouped and shown as units. Discounts are measured against the site’s own regular price.

Market prices were checked on 19–20 October 2026 and haven’t been rechecked since from the linked stores and price trackers. They move often, and auction stock may not carry the brand warranty, so confirm both before buying. Categories come from keywords in each title, so a few items may sit in the wrong group.
